title: Belligerent & Defiant Woman’s Failed Attempt to Evade Arrest!
description:
On September 17th, 2023, officers in New Mexico received a report of a Chevy driving erratically near an intersection. The reporting party was concerned that the driver appeared to be under the influence. Officers located the vehicle improperly parked on the side of the intersection. As an officer approached, the female driver stated she was going to leave and attempted to drive the vehicle. 

As the situation escalated, the female suspect was stopped by the officers from driving away.  Officers removed the suspect from the vehicle, placing her under arrest on the sidewalk as backup arrived. The suspect continued to argue with officers as they escorted her to a patrol car, where they later transported her to jail. At the jail, the suspect continued arguing and lunged at an officer.

The suspect was charged with Aggravated Assault, Resisting, Evading, or Obstructing an Officer, and No Seat Belts.
